reviews.text: The staff is knowledgeable, fun and awesome.  My dog loves going there. I really trust Dr. Davis' expertise and care for my dog.

Everyone is always nice, caring, and attentive about whichever pet I’m bringing in. I’ve never felt rushed or looked over when there. All the staff is also very accommodating from booking the appointment to the end of the visit

Lynette Davis, one of the assistance, seems very unknowledgeable on care for small pets. She’s hasty and rough handling. Due to her services, i lost my pet when he was already in a vulnerable state. I can’t say anything about the other care techs as i haven’t had experience with them but please be cautious if Lynette Davis is assigned to help you with your pet. Avoid if possible. I don’t understand why they would have her there unsupervised by more experienced techs.
Always caring and personable. They are efficient in communication pre and post.  Appreciate their service and compassion for my sweet puppy!

Brought my baby box tortoise here because he was not eating and is immunocompromised. When attempting a syringe feed, the vet tore his entire lower mandible with her ungloved hands and it bled. She then picked him up by just his head to set him back down after wiping off the blood. He passed away soon after. This place is probably great for some creatures, but not all.
Personal attention from all staff who were willing to go above and beyond to help us and our pup

One of our little dogs injured her leg jumping off the sofa on a Friday evening, after the vet's office was closed for the weekend. I called ACGSVH Monday morning, and we were able to get an appt with Dr Davis later that same morning. Vet and staff were very compassionate, professional, and knowledgable. Dr Davis was able to determine right away what the injury was, and what the treatment options are. She printed out explanations of the "drawer test" she used to determine the injury, and treatment options, and included estimated costs. We were given a list of emergency and specialty veterinary practices, and referral to a specific veterinary surgery specialist to have a consult with. Dr Davis prescribed pain meds for our dog, to keep her as comfortable as possible until she could be seen by the specialist.

Dr.Davis and her staff are courteous, caring, and patient with their clients and pets.

The texting system makes it convenient and easy to get in touch and schedule appointments.

They have boarding services and a very nice turtle in the waiting room.

Dr. Davis and her team were absolutely wonderful and took such great care of my girl, Lucy. I highly recommend them to anyone looking for a caring and compassionate veterinary team! If I could give them more than 5 stars, I would!

⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐

I absolutely loved my experience at All Creatures Great and Small. The doctor was incredible, and the entire staff was amazing, compassionate, and welcoming.

I recently lost one of my dogs, and unfortunately, the experience surrounding his care made me realize how important it was for me to find a veterinarian I could truly trust. I visited three different veterinary practices trying to find the right fit before coming here, which was recommended by my dog trainer.

From my first visit, I just knew. It felt like home. ❤️ They listened to me, I felt heard and acknowledged, and most importantly, I could genuinely feel the love and care they showed my pets. I never felt rushed or like we were just another appointment.

I came in hoping to find a veterinarian I could build a long-term relationship with, and I left feeling like I had finally found our vet. That feeling of trust and knowing your babies are in good hands means everything. 🐾❤️

Thank you to the entire team for making our first visit such a wonderful experience!

-sincerely Monica, Kobe, and Del-Y-Cat ❤️
Outstanding veterinarian. One of the best in San Antonio!
Very nice staff! Glad this place was able to help our hamster, not every vet does small animals. So grateful our pet is getting the help he needs.
Thanks, we appreciate you!
Staff is always very kind and helpful and they do a great job taking care of my buns.
Extremely rabbit savvy vet. I found Dr. Davis through my local rabbit rescue. Prices are more affordable than most exotic vets. My rabbits always receive the best care here.
They are very kind, unlike other places. Thanks to their experience, my beautiful little flirt is already feeling better 💕💕 …
Everyone was kind and very informative. Appreciate how quickly i was able to be seen. Will continue to take our bunny there.
Everyone is always friendly and Dr. Davis takes great care of our dogs.

Rapid response to concerns about pets change of condition.
Clear information about onboarding
Excellent reception on arrival and medical care including instructions on follow up

I absolutely loved our experience! 🥹💚 The doctor was seriously amazing so kind, caring, and patient with us. She took the time to explain everything and gave us different options for Greg’s care, which I really appreciated.

You can truly tell that both the doctor and the entire staff genuinely care about the animals they see. Everyone was so gentle, loving, and careful with Greg, my leopard gecko, and that meant so much to me. 🦎💕

I will definitely be coming back and will be bringing the rest of my pets here to be seen by her as well!
Staff and vet are very knowledgeable and always gentle with my pets! I’ve been going to them for several years now.
Easy to get an appointment fairly quickly and little wait time to see a teh or veterinarian. Excellent service! They made my kitten feel less scared by offering a treat. Answered all my questions.
As always staff is kind and communicative.  The service and care is always exceptional.  Thanks for taking care of our family!
Very friendly staff. Took great care of my hamster.
They’re available, honest, transparent, caring and animals best interest always first.
Very friendly and good care.  I use then as a vet fir my dog and also to board him when we go out of town.
Had an awesome experience my kitty had dental cleaning  and dr. Davis explained everything she was very gentle & compassionate.

Dr. Davis is hands-down the best vet we’ve found for our rabbits. She has deep knowledge of bunny-specific care, which is hard to come by, and it’s such a relief to have a vet we fully trust with them. Rosie is also wonderful, and always so caring with our bunnies. Highly recommend to any rabbit owner.
Thank you!

Dr. Davis has lovingly tended to all of my fur babies for many years. Her staff are kind, knowledgeable, and attentive. Amazingly, we often get worked in when something acute is going on. That fact alone is priceless.
Great team! Everyone is knowledgeable and friendly. Clean space. Lovely doctor who explains things to you very well.
Thank you, we really appreciate it!

We had a rabbit emergency after hours and Dr. Davis continued to follow up via text while we are the emergency vet clinic. Her staff is awesome and helpful. We take all our pets there and always a good experience. (3 dogs, 3 cats, 2 rabbits, 2 geckos, 1 snake)
Dr.Davis and her team are top notch. Very caring and compassionate.  Highly recommend.  Bodie loves ya'll!!

ACGSVH has always taken great care of all of my animals. Dr. Davis and the Vet Techs  are wonderful with all of my fur babies, and my dog happily walks in the door! I highly recommend this vet practice!

The staff and veterinarian at All Creatures Great and Small Veterinary Hospital were incredibly friendly and helpful from start to finish. They made us feel comfortable right away and were amazing with our tortoise, Sheldon, who we found out is actually a girl! lol…They took the time to explain everything clearly. Such a great experience and we truly appreciated their care, kindness, and professionalism.

Dr. Davis cares for three of our dogs since they were puppies. On short notice, she would allow us to bring our puppy up there and be a “fill in” in between appointments when it is urgent. She truly cares!

Has a family like environment, they care for our babies!
The team is always so nice and professional. They know how to handle animals that are being difficult with grace and care.
Staff is nice and Dr.Davis is thorough. She communicates well and explains things.
Staff is friendly and caring about  my dogs. I’ve gone here since they first opened many years ago and I have been pleased with the care.
Always very kind and have taken great care of my cats for 10+ years! Highly recommend.
Thanks so much!
Dr Davis and her staff are great! They will treat you and your furry friends wonderfully!
Thank you so much! We really appreciate you!
Thank you so much, Susan! We really appreciate it!

Dr. Davis and her staff were very professional, kind, and attentive during our visit. She took the time to clearly explain everything and made sure I didn’t feel rushed during the appointment.
I especially appreciated that she was willing to accommodate us even though her schedule was full because my pet was sick. That level of care truly meant a lot.
Dr. Davis is always professional and tells you what is going on with your pet.  She has taken care of my pets for years.  The vet technician are very good.  They are gentle and caring for my pets
Thank you, Ms. Gerst!
Everyone there is so nice they also make sure when leaving there was no dogs that were put and could attack my bunnies as I was leaving and they opened the door electronically for me so sweet ty :D
They are very compassionate to my fur baby
Awesome vet. Great staff. Very highly recommend
Dr. Davis is kind, caring, and an excellent Vet.  Her staff is always professional and responsive - thank you so much!

I just wanted to take a moment to express how grateful I am for the wonderful staff at the clinic. They were incredibly kind, patient, and understanding. Being in a stressful situation with my pet was very difficult for me, but the team truly helped me feel calm and reassured throughout the entire process.
I really appreciated the way they treated my pet with such care and compassion. It was clear that they genuinely care about the animals they treat, and that meant a lot to me. The staff also took the time to clearly explain everything that was happening, answering my questions and making sure I understood the situation and the treatment options.
Their professionalism, empathy, and dedication made a very hard moment much easier to handle. I’m truly thankful for the care they provided to both my pet and me.
Dr. Davis and her team are wonderful. We've trusted them with our bunnies for years.

Been coming to ACGSVH for about 10 years with my multiple dogs, who are family to me.
Dr Davis and staff set the bar high on being friendly and courteous, and giving me total comfort in knowing they have the best concerns for my "kids". ❤️🐾 …

Dr. Davis always has the best interest of our pets.  She has given multiple pets extended time with us but also with quality of life.  She is a trusted professional.  Her staff are also professional and have a warm way of greeting us and our pet “family”. Their work and interactions with our pets also have my highest trust.  Together they have guided us through good and hard times.  Simply the best.

Dr. Davis and her staff is amazing. Extremely knowledgeable and so empathetic. We came in due to our baby sulcata tortoise being lethargic. They saw us immediately. Our baby was unfortunately too far gone but we opted to keep trying. They gave him a round of antibiotics and some vials to take home to administer. Unfortunately our little Tortie didn’t make it. They just overall gave us a great experience even when the outcome wasn’t what we hoped for. I got another sulcata and will be taking him back to this office! Pic 1 is Tortie, pic 2 is our Timothy both at the vet office. ❤️‍🩹

I’ve been taking my dogs with Dr. Davis, for over 10 years, and I truly can’t imagine trusting anyone else with their care. The entire team is incredibly compassionate, patient, and genuinely loves animals. They always take the time to explain things clearly, never rush appointments, and treat my dogs like family. Their pricing is fair and transparent, and I’ve never felt pushed into unnecessary treatments. It’s such a comfort knowing my pets are in caring, knowledgeable hands. Highly recommend to anyone looking for a vet they can trust long-term.
Great experience bringing my rabbit here. The staff is kind and very accommodating! They take great care of my bunny every time. This clinic goes above and beyond. Highly recommend!
There’s so many veterinaries around this area that are better and cheaper. I DO NOT RECOMMEND THIS PLACE
Brought our second tortoise in “Dolly” and they  were so helpful . Answered all our questions, thank you to the doctor and great crew . PS she had a upper respiratory infection.
Liked this vet-fast and affordable service. They took care of my cat 🐈 and the staff is really nice and knowledgeable.
Outstanding veterinary. Takes very good care of my dogs. Been a customer for years. Started with Dr Ernst and continue with Dr Davis.
Love how much they care about my guinea pigs! 🥰 Highly recommend if you have small pets.
10/10 recommend. Staff was very attentive and helpful on educating me on bunny care! Within 3 days my bunny showed improvement. Price is fair as well. Overall, great experience.

Best vet in San Antonio for an exotic pets or bunnies. The staff is always attentive and the Doc is the best your pet can get.I highly recommend this vet office, they will take care of your words and buddies so they live long fruitful lives
We love Dr. Davis and her team. We have been coming to this clinic for a decade with multiple patients. Very affordable. Highly recommend 🙂 …
TY!
My building, Stella, receives exceptional care here. I absolutely recommend this place over any other vet in the city. Thank you for all you do!

Dealing with the staff is like dealing with a used car salesman.  I have never experienced a vet that pushes so many unnecessary procedures and supplements just to make an extra buck.  This is the most expensive vet I have ever dealth with.  I will not be returning.

Love everything about this place. The front office is great when checking in and whenever I ask questions over the phone. Love the Dr and her assistants they are so patient and accommodating. I have some big but nervous pups and they take their time to try to get them comfortable. I’m a nervous girl and the Dr explains things to me on my level. Best of all, they are affordable especially for the quality of service you receive.

I love this place, i use them for my bearded dragon and my blue tongue skink, sadly my skink has scale rot, and the price for the checkup AND medicine was only 120 which wasnt even bad! They answer all questions i have and communicate amazingly! 10/10 recommend especially for exotics!
Amazing staff! Love the doctor! Bandit is in good hands.

This facility saved my cats life! Everyone here is so helpful & knowledgeable. I’m forever grateful for Dr. Davis & Sam for helping me and giving me the best recommendations on her care. It’s a clean, quaint office with a staff who takes great pride in their work. Highly recommend this veterinary clinic to everyone!

The vet was very kind and informative, even gave me some print outs on ways to optimize my exotic pets health and well-being. The cost for the visit was 99$ which seems fair to me for an exotic pet. Overall a great experience!

Trying to find a new vet since moving to Austin just made me realize how lucky I got with All Creatures Great & Small in San Antonio. This was about 1 1/2 years ago but I thought better late than never to write a good review. It was difficult finding a veterinary hospital that treated exotic animals, but they were exceptional. I took my chameleon Elio in because of a bump i found on his nose which turned out to be an abscess. He ended up having to have surgery to have it removed. The vet was very thorough with her explanation of what the procedure would look like and the aftercare and medication I would need to provide for him. During his procedure they updated me regularly with how he was doing which was very reassuring. The entire staff was always so friendly and actually seemed to genuinely care about me and my pets. There was one lady who had a floral tattoo on her arm that was always so sweet. I took my cat Wybie in for regular checkups as well and even Wybie picked up on the good vibes-m he's never been that well behaved at a vet. I really miss this place and sometimes I think about making the drive because it would be worth it.

I took my green cheek concure bird on an emergency.They were amazing. I can't ding them for the time wait it was a little long and a bit pricey. Keep in mind it's a hospital . They kept updating me with what was going on with my baby. I hope I never have to use them again. If I do I will use them.

Dr. Davis and her crew are awesome. I have been taking my fur babies to this location, before Dr. Davis was there, and the quality of care has not changed. Although we live 45 minutes away from her location, we still bring them into her for …
They took great care of my neices snake.. it had a small burn ... wonderful staff and vet ... and very reasonable on price.
